items.computation: The letter is internally inconsistent: the header 'Datum' field reads 30.07.2027, but the body states 'mit diesem Bescheid vom 28.07.2027'. Per the rule to use the earliest plausible date when a letter contradicts itself, the posting day is taken as 28.07.2027 (Wednesday). This is a municipal building authority (Bauaufsicht), not a Finanzamt, so the statutory 4-day delivery fiction applies without the weekend/holiday shift that only applies to tax offices: delivery is deemed on 28.07.2027 + 4 calendar days = 01.08.2027 (Sunday), and this day is not moved even though it is a Sunday. The one-month Klage period (§ 74 VwGO) begins the day after delivery (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends on the day of the following month bearing the same date number as the delivery day (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): 01.08.2027 + 1 month = 01.09.2027 (Wednesday). This date is not a Saturday, Sunday or NRW public holiday, so no further shift under § 57 VwGO i.V.m. § 222 Abs. 2 ZPO is needed. Final deadline for filing the Klage: 01.09.2027. (Using the later header date of 30.07.2027 instead would move the delivery to 03.08.2027 and the deadline to 03.09.2027 — the earlier date is used here to be safe.)
